protocol.not_open: The connection sent a request before it opened. Reconnect and try again.
protocol.bad_frame: binference could not read a message from this client. Update the client and try again.
protocol.unknown_op: This version of binference does not know that request. Update binference or the client.
protocol.bad_args: The request leaves something out or holds something wrong. Check what you entered and try again.
protocol.busy: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
protocol.too_large: The request is too large. Split it into smaller parts.
protocol.key_reused: This request repeats an earlier one with different details. Start the action again.
protocol.key_required: This client sent a change without a request id, so binference cannot tell a retry from a new change. Update the client and try again.
protocol.version: This client and binference speak different protocol versions. Update the older one.
auth.required: This client is not signed in. Sign in, then try again.
auth.invalid: Signing in failed. Pair this device again with `binference console`.
auth.expired: Your access expired. Open the console or the Mini App again.
auth.revoked: This device was removed. Pair it again with `binference console`.
auth.origin: This page's address may not connect. Open the console from the link `binference console` prints.
auth.scope: This client may not do that. Use the console or the CLI on the machine.
auth.local_only: This works only on the machine binference runs on. Use the CLI there.
engine.starting: binference is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
engine.stopping: binference is shutting down. Start it again with `binference start`.
engine.locked: binference is locked. Run `binference unlock` on the machine.
engine.timeout: binference did not finish in time. Try again.
runtime.unavailable: Your agent is offline right now. Run `binference check` to see why.
agent.not_found: This agent does not exist. Check the list of agents in the console.
agent.archived: This agent is archived. Create a new agent, or pick another one.
agent.frozen: This agent is frozen. Unfreeze it in the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
agent.paper_only: This agent is in paper mode, and this action needs live. Go live with `binference live`.
agent.disclaimer: Accept the disclaimer before going live. Run `binference live` and follow the steps.
wallet.not_found: This wallet does not exist. Check the list of wallets in the console.
wallet.unfunded: This wallet has no funds yet. Fund it with BNB, then try again.
wallet.bad_owner_key: This owner key does not match the wallet. Check that you entered the right one.
wallet.custody_down: The wallet service is not responding, so nothing was signed. Try again in a minute.
intent.not_found: binference has no record of this action. Refresh and try again.
intent.wrong_state: This action already moved on: it was confirmed, cancelled or sent. Refresh to see where it stands.
intent.expired: This action expired before you confirmed it. Ask your agent again.
intent.card_changed: The price moved and the terms changed. Check the new quote, then confirm again.
intent.not_yours: Another client started this action, so this one cannot cancel it. Cancel it in the console or the CLI.
order.not_found: This auto order does not exist. Check your auto orders in the console.
order.wrong_state: This auto order already ended or changed. Refresh to see where it stands.
asset.not_found: binference does not know this token. Paste its contract address instead.
asset.bad_address: This is not a valid address. Check it and paste it again.
name.not_found: No address is registered for this name. Check the spelling.
name.resolver_down: The name service is not responding. Try again later, or paste the address.
quote.no_route: No route for this trade right now. Try a smaller amount or another token.
quote.venue_down: The venue for this trade is not responding. Try again in a minute.
chain.rpc_down: binference cannot reach the network right now. Try again in a minute, and check your internet connection if it lasts.
chain.simulation_failed: The simulation of this transaction failed, so nothing was sent. Check the amounts and try again.
limit.needs_admin: A looser limit needs the CLI, the console or the Mini App.
limit.over_ceiling: This limit is above the wallet's ceiling. Raise the ceiling with your owner key first.
config.invalid: The config has an error. Run `binference check` to see where and how to fix it.
config.secret_inline: A secret is written as plain text in config. Run `binference check --fix`.
plugin.not_found: This plugin is not installed. Check the list of plugins in the console.
plugin.hash_mismatch: This plugin's files do not match their pinned hash, so it was not loaded. Install it again from its source.
plugin.review_needed: This plugin asks for new permissions. Review them in the console before it runs.
job.not_found: This task does not exist or ended long ago. Start it again if you still need it.
internal.error: binference hit an internal error. Run `binference report` to make a support file without secrets.
